title: TMB Foundation, MSSRF demonstrate impact of pilot coastal development project in Thoothukudi

ai.summary: TMB Foundation and MSSRF held a workshop in Thoothukudi to review outcomes from a coastal development pilot project in two villages, sharing community experiences and lessons learned.

facts.claim: TMB Foundation in partnership with M.S. Swaminathan Research Foundation (MSSRF) has organised a project outcome dissemination workshop in Thoothukudi
facts.quote: TMB Foundation in partnership with M.S. Swaminathan Research Foundation (MSSRF) has organised a project outcome dissemination workshop in Thoothukudi, to review the outcomes and key learnings from the pilot initiative implemented in the coastal villages of Keela Vaippar and Pattinamarudhur in the district.

facts.claim: Community representatives from Pattinamarudhur and Keela Vaippar shared their experiences and changes observed at household and village levels
facts.quote: Community representatives from Pattinamarudhur and Keela Vaippar shared their experiences and changes observed at household and village levels, a press release issued on Friday said.

facts.claim: As part of the workshop, community reflection booklets documenting experiences, early changes and lessons from two the villages were released
facts.quote: As part of the workshop, community reflection booklets documenting experiences, early changes and lessons from two the villages were released, providing a field based account of the implementation process and community perspectives.

facts.claim: A documentation film capturing the pilot journey was also screened
facts.quote: A documentation film capturing the pilot journey was also screened.

facts.claim: Velvizhi, Director, Fisheries and Livelihoods Programme, MSSRF presented the project approach, implementation process, emerging outcomes, key learnings and next course of actions
facts.quote: During the programme, Velvizhi, Director, Fisheries and Livelihoods Programme, MSSRF presented the project approach, implementation process, emerging outcomes, key learnings and next course of actions.

facts.claim: She highlighted that developing resilient fishing villages requires a long-term integrated and collective approach that brings together communities, government departments, research institutions and development partners
facts.quote: She highlighted that developing resilient fishing villages requires a long-term integrated and collective approach that brings together communities, government departments, research institutions and development partners.

facts.claim: Saravanan, project director of District Rural Development Agency emphasised the importance of adopting an integrated approach for the development of villages, rather than addressing livelihood and social needs through separate interventions
facts.quote: Saravanan, project director of District Rural Development Agency emphasised the importance of adopting an integrated approach for the development of villages, rather than addressing livelihood and social needs through separate interventions.

facts.claim: TMB Foundation’s CEO Muthiah, highlighted the longstanding partnership between TMB Foundation and MSSRF and emphasised the importance of collaborative efforts in strengthening fishing communities
facts.quote: TMB Foundation’s CEO Muthiah, highlighted the longstanding partnership between TMB Foundation and MSSRF and emphasised the importance of collaborative efforts in strengthening fishing communities.

ai.background_note: TMB Foundation and MSSRF conducted a workshop in Thoothukudi to review outcomes from a coastal development pilot project in two villages, focusing on community experiences and lessons learned.
